agents.bio:
Marsha Watson is a North Carolina REALTOR® with eXp Realty and the team lead of Core Collective Real Estate. Serving Raleigh, Cary, Clayton, Garner, Wendell, Zebulon, Four Oaks, Rocky Mount, Goldsboro, and surrounding Wake and Johnston County communities, Marsha helps buyers and sellers make confident real estate decisions through education, strategy, and personalized guidance.

Before real estate, Marsha spent more than 20 years in nonprofit and mental health work, including advocacy for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. That background shaped her client-first approach and deep commitment to helping people find stability, opportunity, and long-term wealth through homeownership.

Marsha specializes in first-time homebuyers, military relocation for families PCSing to Fort Liberty and Seymour Johnson AFB, VA buyers, relocation clients, new construction, and sellers preparing for their next chapter. As a Military Relocation Professional and Certified eXp Mentor, she brings strong communication, local market knowledge, and steady guidance to every transaction.

Her approach is warm, honest, and educational. She believes clients deserve more than a transaction — they deserve an advocate who listens, explains the process clearly, and protects their goals from consultation to closing. At Core Collective Real Estate, the mission is clear: 
Your Goals. Our Core Mission.

agents.bio:
Buying or selling a home is a major decision, and having the right guidance can make all the difference.
As a Realtor® and retired military professional, I bring a combination of strategic thinking, disciplined execution, and genuine client care to every transaction. My personal experience navigating relocations, homeownership, and sales gives me an understanding of the financial and emotional decisions that come with real estate.

Before entering real estate, I built a career in business development, project management, and performance improvement, where negotiation, problem-solving, and delivering results were essential. Today, I apply those same skills to help clients understand their options, make informed decisions, and move forward with confidence.

Whether you're buying your first home, selling, relocating, or exploring your next investment, my goal is simple: make the process clear, manageable, and focused on your goals.
When you're ready to make your next move, I'm ready to help.
Your Goals. Our Mission.

agents.bio:
Sharon Burwell McDuffie is a dedicated real estate professional with Core Collective Real Estate Group, known for her steady guidance, client‑centered approach, and deep commitment to helping individuals and families find places where their lives can truly flourish. She brings a warm, relationship‑driven style to her work, pairing market expertise with genuine care for the people she serves.

Sharon’s approach to real estate is shaped by her belief in community, service, and the power of home. She understands that buying or selling a home is more than a transaction—it’s a milestone that can strengthen families, build stability, and open doors to new opportunities. Her clients value her thoughtful communication, her ability to simplify complex decisions, and her unwavering dedication to their goals.

Her work in real estate is deeply connected to the way she shows up in her community. Sharon is an active member of her local church, serving faithfully as a deaconess, Children’s Church teacher, and member of the Events Ministry, where her organizational talent and welcoming spirit shine. She also extends her leadership beyond the church walls as the Chaplain of the Raleigh Chapter of Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Incorporated, offering encouragement, compassion, and spiritual grounding to her sorors.

Family is at the heart of Sharon’s life. She is the proud mother of two adult daughters and is married to Ty McDuffie, founder of Griot and Grits, whose work in cultural preservation and storytelling aligns with her own commitment to community uplift. Together, they share a passion for service, legacy building, and creating spaces—both literal and figurative—where people feel supported and empowered.

Whether guiding a first‑time buyer, supporting a family preparing to sell a longtime home, or helping clients navigate investment opportunities, Sharon brings warmth, integrity, and a steady hand to every step of the journey. Her work reflects not only her professional skill, but her belief in strengthening communities one home at a time.

agents.bio:
Jennifer Wiggins believes great real estate service starts with listening, continues with education, and is backed by strong advocacy from the first conversation to the closing table.

Originally from Connecticut and the daughter of Caribbean immigrants, Jennifer grew up with an appreciation for hard work, family, and opportunity.

With a professional background in sales and leadership, Jennifer brings strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills to her work in real estate.

As a REALTOR® with Core Collective Real Estate Team, brokered by eXp Realty, her clients can expect honest communication, thoughtful guidance, and strong advocacy throughout their real estate experience.

Outside of real estate, you can find Jennifer traveling, enjoying great food, reading a good book, or participating in various forms of performing arts throughout the community.

Your Goals. Our Core Mission
